author: espoirschooloflife
title: Hiring Storybook Illustrator (Paid Project)
content:
🎨 WE ARE HIRING: STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATOR (Paid Project)

Espoir School of Life is looking for a creative Storybook Illustrator who can capture the stories written about Espoir School of Life.

Espoir School of Life is a non-profit organization that provides free, inclusive, and liberating education alongside holistic community development programs for underprivileged children and their families in Siargao.

The stories are already written, and we now need an artist to bring these local narratives, community impacts, and grassroots projects to life through vibrant illustrations.

✨ How to Apply:

If you want to help us bring these island narratives to life, please fill out our application form here: bit.ly/espoir-SI

Be ready to share your:
• Contact Information
• Portfolio Link
• Expected Rate/Project Quotation

We can’t wait to see your work! 🌴✨

author: imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists, and invests in human made work consistently!! He is really good people and really knows his shit. Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and “branded” designs, will rotate roster of thumbnail of various artists for features!! (See pinned comment for more!) ‼️ The bulk of the work would be for channel art with fast turnaround time for his video content, and wants HUMAN MADE not AI! ‼️ Some requests will be less complicated, like thumbnail artwork, but other requests may be more detailed or specific, so flexibility is KEY! ‼️ Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing, but send your portfolios of comics art so he can see who’s out here! ‼️ You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates for consideration along with your samples if requested! ‼️ Potential for additional work as needed down the line if it goes well! ‼️I promise he is legitimate and real and worthy of your time and effort, and is worth submitting your work to as he will be respectful and professional! Everyone is welcome to throw their hat into the ring if you wanna be considered for this very special YouTube channel! COMMENT BELOW AND LET’S SEE WHERE IT LEADS YALL!
